Guidelines for Hygiene & Impact on PO
- Policy premium dissonances viz; non-receipt of premium due to cheque dishonour or other mode of payment beyond 7 days, 2.5% PO shall be recovered.
- Policy premium dissonances viz; non-receipt of premium due to cheque dishonour or other mode of payment beyond 15 days, 4.0% PO shall be recovered.
- For any discrepancy in risk attributes viz; RTO code, GVW banding, Seating Capacity, Make, Model, Fuel Type, CC Banding, product category, insured name etc. full commission shall be recoverable.
